extract: DOHMH restaurant inspection results, inspection_date from 2024-06-03 up to but not including 2024-06-05. 628 violation rows, 164 inspections (one per camis and inspection_date).

questions.question: Count one inspection per restaurant per date: the same camis and inspection_date is one inspection, even when several violation rows repeat it. How many of those inspections have each grade? Skip inspections with no grade.
questions.how: Dropped duplicate camis and inspection_date, then dropped the 84 inspections with no grade.

questions.question: Count one inspection per restaurant per date: the same camis and inspection_date is one inspection. What is the mean score in each borough? Skip inspections with no score.
questions.how: One row per camis and inspection_date, dropped 6 inspections with no score, then the mean of score. Rounded to 4 decimals. Counts used: Bronx 15, Brooklyn 51, Manhattan 54, Queens 33, Staten Island 5.

questions.question: How many violation rows have critical_flag equal to Critical for each cuisine_description?
questions.how: Counted rows, not inspections. A cuisine with no Critical row is left out. 333 Critical rows.
